about: Automatic name of a main agent (ADR-095 section 1, 06-web.md section 4.0a): derived from the task's current title when the task has no verified task.agent_name event or its newest one names null. Whitespace = the Unicode White_Space property (the set of tasks/title.json). text = the title with every whitespace run replaced by one space, leading and trailing spaces removed; name = its first max_words space-separated words joined by one space; when name has more than max_code_points code points: take its first max_code_points + 1 code points and cut before the last space among them, or (no space after the first code point) keep the first max_code_points code points; an empty name is the value of empty. Clients show a main agent as "<name> #<number>".
